settings.brief: Affordable compact two-storey family infill home: white lower walls, charcoal upper front/rear cladding, one ordinary pitched gable roof, timber front door with a narrow side-light, broad front living window, rear GLASS patio slider and FOUR solar modules in two rows of two ONLY on the fixed front roof slope. Rear roof does not acquire the solar panels when turned. No garage, flat-roof sci-fi shapes or mansion scale.
settings.identity_policy: All doors/windows/balconies/roof panels belong to one fixed world; never substitute front geometry on rear or move panels to the camera-facing roof.
